text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I brought Red Desire to the shrine for a change of pace, since she's been in a bit of a slump lately.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, how delightfully pleasant...
It feels as though both body and soul are being cleansed."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A shrine is a pure and undefiled place,
one that could truly be called a sanctuary.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"There is no place more fitting
for a Saint to rest than thi—"

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... What should I do about this...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, such a pained voice is quite unbefitting of a sacred place...
Let us go check on it, Trainer-san."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Um, is something troubling you?
If you'd like, I, the Saint Red Desire,
would be happy to listen.

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a-a saint...?
No, but maybe...

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
"Truth is, our shrine maiden suddenly fell ill
and couldn't make it..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Goodness, it must be tough being so short-handed.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"A shrine maiden and a saint—both bear sacred duties.
Very well.
Allow this Red Desire to lend a helping hand!"

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text: R-Really? That'd be a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
You're worrying about me, aren't you, Trainer?
It's true that I haven't fully recovered from feeling unwell.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: However, extending a helping hand to those in need is only natural for a saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: You needn't worry, I shall perform my duties admirably!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Hello. Are you looking for an amulet?
We offer a wide variety, including charms for family safety, traffic safety, safe childbirth, and victory.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You must be the ones with a prayer service reservation.
Please fill this out,
and submit it along with your offering fee.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Impurity preys upon the smallest vulnerabilities.
Let us stay vigilant and clean every last corner thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Spirits of the wind, will you lend me
your aid? Then please gather
the leaves over this way.
choice_data_list: Wow, they've really got it together...!
Wow, you've really got it together...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching while helping out, I realized a shrine maiden's duties were surprisingly wide-ranging.
To handle all of it effortlessly—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it is nothing to be so surprised about.
Surely, it is simply the result
of your daily training manifesting itself.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"A Saint's duties are by no means limited
to fighting evil, praying, and holding rituals."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Standing by the common folk
and reaching out a helping hand
is an equally vital mission."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If one neglects this, no matter how much
power they possess, they cannot be called a Saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now, there is still a mountain of things to do.
Let us carry out our duties properly until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Phew. The task is successfully completed.
So, how did I do? How was my work?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Never complaining about the heavy workload,
she tackled it with enthusiasm.
I was deeply impressed by her humble attitude.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, that is wonderful to hear.
I shall forget all about feeling under the weather and devote myself to my shrine maiden duties—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... come to think of it, my body feels
remarkably refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that God was watching
my work?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"—I give my heartfelt thanks
for granting your divine favor
even to one who aims for another world."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether there was truly divine protection remains uncertain,
but Red Desire had successfully regained
her top form.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...? I'm feeling, a bit lightheaded...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
F-Fufu... Are you tired from unfamiliar work?
Seems your training is still lacking...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because she overdid it,
Red Desire couldn't get back into
condition for quite some time.
